entities.summary: Robert Owen Keohane is an American political scientist working in the fields of international relations and international political economy. Following the publication of his influential book After Hegemony (1984), he has become widely associated with the theory of neoliberal institutionalism in international relations, as well as transnational relations and world politics in international relations in the 1970s. Robert Keohane was a writers & intellectuals from Chicago (b. 1941-11-03, Chicago). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
